title: Dual-Band Weighted Trade-Off Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Explicitly weighting the two wavelength bands equally in the objective function will achieve balanced reflectance performance across both bands, revealing the fundamental trade-off between O-band and C-band optimization.
design_principle: Dual-band AR coatings require thickness combinations that create interference minima at two distinct wavelength ranges; equal weighting forces the optimizer to find solutions that do not sacrifice one band for the other, exposing the Pareto frontier of the design space.
proposed_topology: air | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | si (13 layers total: 6 high-low pairs plus substrate, reduced to 12 to meet constraint)
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses for all 12 coating layers, each varied between 20-400 nm
soft_objectives: minimize weighted average reflectance with equal weight on 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm bands
minimize reflectance difference between the two bands
manufacturing_considerations: 12 coating layers at maximum allowed count increases fabrication complexity and cost
all thicknesses within 20-400 nm manufacturable range
ta2o5 and sio2 deposition requires tight thickness control for 12 layers
theory_basis: Pareto frontier analysis for trade-off quantification
Transfer matrix method for band-specific reflectance calculation
expected_advantages: Explicit trade-off handling reveals balanced solutions
Maximum layer count provides greatest optimization freedom
Equal weighting prevents one band from dominating the objective
known_risks: Maximum layer count may be impractical for some fabrication processes
Equal weighting may not match actual system requirements
execution_request_english: Design a dual-band anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate. Incident medium: air. Substrate: semi-infinite si. Coating stack: Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) (12 layers, 6 pairs). Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm with equal weighting in objective. Incidence: 0 deg, unpolarized. Optimize all 12 layer thicknesses independently within 20-400 nm range. Objective: minimize weighted average reflectance with equal weight on both bands, plus minimize reflectance difference between bands. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, thicknesses_nm, and band-specific average reflectance and transmittance into silicon.
